name: mysteel-data
description: Mysteel commodity data skill pack for prices, news, market analysis, research reports, customs, weather, agricultural balances, business leads, and charts.
description_cn: 钢联数据大宗商品能力包，支持智能问数、实时资讯、市场分析、研报、海关、气象、农产品供需、商机和图表。

presentation.summary: 查询钢联大宗商品数据与资讯，并生成分析、研报和图表。
presentation.access_note: 查询文本、筛选条件和图表数据会发送到钢联数据服务；产物默认保存在当前会话工作区。

config_fields.name: MYSTEEL_API_KEY
config_fields.label: 钢联 API Key
config_fields.help: 仅保存在 Cowork 本地能力配置中，运行脚本时临时注入。
config_fields.placeholder: 请输入钢联 Skills API Key

workflow: Read the matching vendored sub-skill reference before choosing arguments.
Use run_skill_script with one of the twelve declared Python entries.
Use only the Cowork-managed MYSTEEL_API_KEY; never pass or persist the key.
Keep generated files inside the active Cowork workspace and report their actual paths.
State that query text and supplied chart data are sent to Mysteel, and surface API errors without changing data sources.
